notes: All four pages were reached sequentially through the real visible Next button. Pagination exposes native buttons without href, and the actual listing URL stays unchanged on every page. No page URL/query was guessed.

Each page retains its DOM card order and displayed tag labels/hrefs. Edge automatically translated visible tag labels into Chinese; original category hrefs are retained. Hidden +N labels are recorded as counts; unexpanded tags remain unknown.
All93 card media URLs are directory metadata only. No card modal was opened and no reference media was played, downloaded, or treated as observed.

Videos have no displayed title or media image-alt; title remains null.91 cards expose a Collect UI designer link; two expose external Post by attribution. Neither external attribution URL is an original-work URL.
No original-work URL is visible in listing cards; originalWorkUrl stays null even when an exact media URL also appears in the existing AI Flow inventory.
Full media URLs define mediaGroups. Every card occurrence is retained even when a duplicate or cross-category association exists. Unique-media count is not the count of distinct original artworks.
Completion means this category pagination snapshot on2026-09-30; the site may update later. The last page still displays Next, but it is disabled.
